lessons.title: Upstream dataclass field insertion breaks Ascend positional construction (AttentionGroup metadata_builders)
lessons.symptom: Many E2E suites fail during KV-cache init: `initialize_attn_backend` -> `calculate_reorder_batch_threshold` -> `AttentionGroup.get_metadata_builder` with `AssertionError` at `assert len(self.metadata_builders) > ubatch_id` (often surfaced as `RuntimeError: Worker failed with error` / `Failed to start data parallel worker`).
lessons.root_cause: Upstream inserted new fields (`kernel_block_size`, `kernel_block_stride`, `kernel_block_table`, `kernel_block_offsets`) into `vllm/v1/worker/utils.py::AttentionGroup` BEFORE the existing `metadata_builders` field. Ascend constructed `AttentionGroup(backend, layer_names, spec, group_id, attn_metadata_builders)` positionally, so on the new tree the builder list landed in `kernel_block_size` and `metadata_builders` stayed empty.
fix_guidance: Grep the vllm-ascend tree for positional constructions of any upstream dataclass the commit touched: rg -n 'ClassName\(' vllm_ascend/.
Compare the field order in the upstream patch before/after (the a/ side of the hunk) to detect inserted fields before existing ones.
Rewrite every Ascend construction of that dataclass to use keyword arguments (valid on both trees when the field name is unchanged).
If only some sites pass the reordered field, fix only those; sites that already use keywords are safe.
Re-grep for sibling construction sites of the same class in vllm_ascend/ and tests/ut/ before finishing (family completeness).
lessons.example: step-17 03a7d377: vllm_ascend/worker/model_runner_v1.py built AttentionGroup with attn_metadata_builders as the 5th positional arg; fixed by passing metadata_builders= by keyword.
